title: Impact of Additional Representative on Public Spending
research_question: Does the allocation of a second representative in districts crossing a population threshold affect public spending per capita? The study aims to understand whether having an additional representative leads to changes in the allocation of public resources.
data_description: The dataset includes 400 observations of districts with variables such as running_var (population size), treated (indicator for districts with a second representative), and y (public spending per capita). The data focuses on districts near the population threshold for receiving a second representative.

ground_truth.identification_strategy: Exploit the population threshold for a second representative as a cutoff for treatment assignment.
ground_truth.conclusion_detail: The presence of a second representative decreases public spending per capita.

_fix_notes.description: Ground-truth effect and direction corrected to match actual data. Root cause: extend_exp_b_to_100.py:267 applied abs() before passing effect to make_rdd(), so the synthetic CSV has positive effect while the JSON recorded the original signed value. Data file unchanged; only JSON metadata updated.
